summary: Verified both fixes from iteration 45. (1) Per-member Excel export now works end-to-end with NO ReferenceError - downloaded Financial_Plan_Rajesh_Kumar.xlsx (Data Sheet + Cash Flow & Portfolio) containing all 5 categorized income sections (REGULAR INCOME, RETIREMENT CORPUS, FIXED INCOME/DEBT INSTRUMENTS, MARKET-LINKED INVESTMENTS, OTHER ASSETS) plus PROPERTY DETAILS. (2) On loading the IncomeSection, PPF/EPF/Gratuity now auto-populate year_to_mature=14 and maturity_value (PPF=₹64,61,026 ≈64L, EPF=₹1,09,98,139 ≈1.1Cr, Gratuity=₹10,74,509 area from calc) matching review expectations. Family-level Calculate + per-member Calculate work; Excel + PDF buttons enable after Calculate. No console errors, no page errors during the full flow.

integration_issues.flow: Excel export vs live-computed Maturity Value
integration_issues.issue: Excel 'RETIREMENT CORPUS' section shows the STORED maturity_value from backend (PPF=₹45,00,000, EPF=₹80,00,000, Gratuity=₹12,00,000) whereas the IncomeSection UI now shows the newly-computed dynamic values (PPF=₹64,61,026, EPF=₹1,09,98,139). Auto-computed maturity_value is only held in the IncomeSection local React state and is NOT persisted; SurplusSection reads directly from incomeDetails coming from backend. If the user does not save (or the record was not saved after the auto-calc code was deployed), Excel will show stale values. Consider either (a) also computing maturity_value in SurplusSection buildDataSheet or (b) auto-saving the computed value when it changes on load.
affected_selectors: Data Sheet > RETIREMENT CORPUS > Maturity Value column

action_items: OPTIONAL: Persist the auto-computed year_to_mature/maturity_value for PPF/EPF/Gratuity to backend on load, or recompute in exportEntityCashFlow to match UI display.
critical_code_review_comments: SurplusSection.jsx still 4561 lines and has three parallel export flows (handleExportToExcel/exportEntityCashFlow/exportSimulationToExcel). Recommend extracting into src/pages/DataGathering/export/{dataGathering,cashflow,simulation}.js with a shared buildIncomeSection() helper.

The family-level Excel button (handleExportToExcel) still uses the LEGACY flat 'Data Gathering' layout; only the per-member Excel export uses the new categorized 'Data Sheet'. Confirm this is intentional; otherwise migrate the family Excel to use the new layout.

Auto-calc of maturity_value (IncomeSection.jsx:385-425) mutates details in place during data mapping. It's not persisted; consider triggering an auto-save or moving the calc to a derived selector so all downstream consumers (Surplus/Excel) see the same value.
Data Sheet skips SECTION 4/5/6 (jumps from SECTION 3 to SECTION 7). Either renumber sections consecutively or add the missing sections.
